description: Sends the message shown by `messages_preview` to the one dealership on one row of a request. It reaches a real dealership and cannot be undone. It takes the `previewToken` that `messages_preview` returned for the same text, the same row and the same `idempotencyKey`. A call repeated with the same `idempotencyKey` returns the first answer and sends no second message.

askId.description: Optional. The `askId` of the dealership's question this message answers, from a message in `messages_list` that carries one. Leave it out if the message answers no question. The preview and the send take the same `askId`.

dealSetId.description: The id of the request, from requests_list.

idempotencyKey.description: A key made up for this one message. The preview and the send take the same key; sending the same key again returns the first answer.

intent.description: Practice requests only. Marks this message as asking the dealership for a lower price, when the buyer asked for one.

previewToken.description: The previewToken that messages_preview returned for this exact text, this row and this idempotencyKey. Valid for 15 minutes.

text.description: The message text, as the buyer wants it said to the dealership. The limit is 1000 characters on an email thread and 600 on a text-message thread.

name: messages_send
title: Send a message
